_comment: Pin for the prebuilt kg binary that plugin/bin/kg-launch.sh downloads (ADR-010). No kg release exists yet, so the pin is intentionally empty: the launcher still resolves kg from AI_PACK_KG or PATH, and its download path exits cleanly into the documented graceful degradation. To populate: cut a kg release, then record its tag, the release download base, and the per-platform sha256 of each kg-<tag>-<platform>.tar.gz. See docs/RELEASING.md.
